concept: Six photoreal water-worn desert/valley boulders (riverbed sandstone/granite): broad smooth planes with a few chipped facets, subtle cracks and pitting, warm grey-brown #6b5a4b base, lighter sun-bleached tops, faint olive moss/lichen in crevices and on upward faces, darker damp ground line.

source.blend: blender/rocks/rocks.blend (game meshes rock_01..06 at the origin; high-poly bake sources rock_0N_high in the Rocks_High collection, hidden)
source.generatorScript: blender/rocks/scripts/rocks_build.py (build_one(name) per rock, atlas_uvs, bake_all, export; deterministic seeds)
source.textures: blender/rocks/textures/rock_atlas_basecolor.png, rock_atlas_normal.png, rock_atlas_orm.png (2048, PNG masters; JPEG 85 inside the GLB)

orientation.origin: every rock's pivot is the centre of its base on the ground (y = 0); x/z centred on the footprint
orientation.transforms: applied: every node has identity translation / rotation / scale

buriedSkirt: each mesh continues 30% of its height below y = 0 so it sits embedded in the ground with no gap; place rocks at ground height and the skirt hides any slope

rock_06.size: pebble cluster piece (three fused flat pebbles)

material.Rock_Atlas: one shared MeshStandardMaterial for all six rocks: baseColorTexture, normalTexture (tangent space, OpenGL +Y), occlusionTexture + metallicRoughnessTexture = the same ORM image (R ambient occlusion, G roughness 0.85-0.92, B metalness 0). Single-sided (closed meshes).
material.atlas: 2048 x 2048, all six rocks packed without overlap at one texel density (~2 px/cm), 8 px bake margin
material.bake: Cycles, high-poly (5k-82k tris) -> game mesh. AO is the high-poly's own occlusion times a ground-contact term that darkens toward y = 0, so instances stay correct wherever they are placed.

threeJsSetup.loading: GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader('/draco/'); gltf.scene children are rock_01..rock_06 meshes. Clone a mesh per placement (mesh.clone() shares geometry + material) or use InstancedMesh with mesh.geometry / mesh.material for many copies.
threeJsSetup.shading: use as loaded. aoMap uses uv (three r15x+ reads the occlusion from the first UV set). castShadow / receiveShadow true works well; vary rotation.y and a uniform scale of 0.8-1.25 per placement to hide repetition.
threeJsSetup.verified: loaded with three r186 GLTFLoader + DRACOLoader: all six meshes, sizes and base heights as listed, maps present (map, normalMap, aoMap, roughnessMap, metalnessMap), no console errors
